schema.name: events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
                    event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
                        event_type IN ('WRONG_WAY', 'STOPPED_VEHICLE', 'CONGESTION')
                    ),
                    timestamp REAL NOT NULL CHECK (timestamp >= 0),
                    confidence REAL NOT NULL CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
                    severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH')),
                    explanation TEXT NOT NULL,
                    camera_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    latitude REAL NOT NULL CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
                    longitude REAL NOT NULL CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180),
                    evidence_image TEXT NOT NULL,
                    details TEXT,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROPOSED' CHECK (
                        status IN ('PROPOSED', 'VERIFIED', 'DISMISSED')
                    ),
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )

known_issues.title: Genuine stopped-event positive acceptance is still missing
known_issues.impact: Core promised event has not passed a natural moved→stop→8s→incident chain.
known_issues.next_action: Capture a natural eligible daytime sequence; label recorded alternatives honestly

known_issues.title: Daylight calibration stays enabled without an automatic condition gate
known_issues.impact: Night quality is poor in historical evidence; NORMAL can still be computed despite unsuitable visibility.
known_issues.next_action: Enforce documented operator night-disable procedure; separately design quality gating

known_issues.title: Recorded review failure can appear successful in the Command Center dialog
known_issues.impact: useEvents catches request failure and resolves; caller unconditionally writes VERIFIED/DISMISSED into selected dialog. DB may remain PROPOSED. Live review has try/finally without catch and no dedicated action-error state.
known_issues.basis: CODE-PATH VERIFIED; failed-write UI not executed
known_issues.next_action: Propagate success/failure, update dialog only from confirmed backend response; add failure regression

known_issues.title: Recorded zero-detection frames disappear from API timeline
known_issues.impact: Rain: 787 processed traffic frames vs 611 detection frames; 176 gaps. Selection carries previous frame counts through gaps.
known_issues.next_action: Join full processed frame timeline, preserve explicit zero counts; test playback gaps

known_issues.title: Backend suite is not green
known_issues.impact: One exact message contract mismatch: 247 pass / 1 fail; numeric fixture fields agree.
known_issues.next_action: Decide intended message contract and align implementation/test in separate task

known_issues.title: Smoke test uses removed roles and mutates real state
known_issues.impact: OPERATOR/REVIEWER user creation is incompatible with ADMIN/EMPLOYEE/CITIZEN; test creates users and reviews incidents.
known_issues.next_action: Update role fixtures and isolate smoke DB/artifacts before execution

known_issues.title: Scheduled backup service is not deployed
known_issues.impact: Only old manual DB copies found; no backup volume in current Docker inventory. Evidence remains a separate unprotected asset.
known_issues.next_action: Enable verified backup plus media/config recovery drill in follow-up

known_issues.title: CityEye is running a demo HTTP deployment, not production perimeter
known_issues.impact: Ports bind all interfaces; no TLS termination in audited stack; no login throttling/MFA. External firewall exposure NOT VERIFIED.
known_issues.next_action: Establish restricted deployment, HTTPS, access policy and abuse protections before pilot exposure

known_issues.title: Citizen confirmation is spoofable demo consensus
known_issues.impact: Public POST trusts demo_user_id; five different client strings are not five verified people.
known_issues.next_action: Do not operationalize COMMUNITY_CONFIRMED until identity/abuse controls exist

known_issues.title: Recorded provenance and source identity are incomplete
known_issues.impact: Congestion DB row has null source identity; recorded UUIDs/filenames can change on rerun, and old DB rows may disappear from Incidents if absent from current artifacts.
known_issues.next_action: Persist scenario identity and immutable run/model/config/media provenance

known_issues.title: Analytics counts and timestamps need careful interpretation
known_issues.impact: Incident join uses camera_name instead of source_id; MODERATE counts as congestion; chart equal-spaces buckets even across missing hours.
known_issues.next_action: Use explicit identity/time semantics and show gaps/coverage

known_issues.title: Maydan integration is playback-ready, not road-calibrated
known_issues.impact: Coordinates are 0,0; polygon covers almost whole image including non-road; direction is generic and event thresholds restrictive. No approval evidence found.
known_issues.next_action: Validate actual site and lane/road geometry before event claims

known_issues.title: Existing stopped output is historical, not a current positive regression
known_issues.impact: PROPOSED artifact is the labeled pre-fix false event; DB correctly DISMISSED. Source video is 1920×1080 while annotated output is 1280×720; run lineage unverified.
known_issues.next_action: Preserve false-positive example, add a distinct genuine positive recording/run manifest

known_issues.title: Unprofiled cameras retain legacy geometry
known_issues.impact: Camera3 is guarded; camera5/7 have no profile, so resolver returns None and shared generic geometry remains available if workers reenabled.
known_issues.next_action: Require per-camera approval before activating other streams

known_issues.title: Repeated reconnects and limited observability prevent reliability claims
known_issues.impact: Snapshot showed 851 reconnect attempts and generation116, but no dependable denominator/uptime SLA; physical cause NOT VERIFIED.
known_issues.next_action: Run a timestamped soak with outage/latency/quality annotations

known_issues.title: Raw MJPEG freshness and retry recovery are weaker than AI metrics
known_issues.impact: Preview checks health at open only; successful image load does not reset retryToken; after accumulated retries a later failure can jump to ERROR.
known_issues.next_action: Exercise intermittent stream recovery and reset per-failure retry budget

known_issues.title: Several frontend pages have stale/error/empty-state ambiguities
known_issues.impact: Camera fetch error becomes no cameras; Incidents/Citizen can initially show empty before fetch; recorded incident lists do not poll in Incidents; analytics refreshes only on filter/retry.
known_issues.next_action: Add explicit load/failure/freshness states and recheck after external reviews

known_issues.title: Review detail presentation/accessibility needs cleanup
known_issues.impact: Verified/dismissed details still say requires verification; stale Reviewer wording; no dialog Escape/focus trap or image-failure fallback.
known_issues.basis: CODE VERIFIED; full viewport audit NOT VERIFIED
known_issues.next_action: Improve review state labels and accessible error handling

known_issues.title: Data lifetime and scale are not bounded
known_issues.impact: All events/lists and recorded CSV parsed eagerly; no runtime observation/evidence retention; JSON delivery list grows; SQLite/filesystem single-host architecture.
known_issues.next_action: Define retention/pagination/archival after measuring one-camera workload

known_issues.title: Safety gate has an unhandled uncalibrated-bicycle path
known_issues.impact: When calibration disables congestion, bicycle_in_road is None, then int(None) raises if an accepted bicycle exists. Camera3 disable/resolution-mismatch conditions can hit this path.
known_issues.basis: CODE-PATH VERIFIED; no live trigger observed
known_issues.next_action: Add isolated regression and null-safe road-membership handling in follow-up

known_issues.title: Historical documentation contradicts current implementation
known_issues.impact: Map/no-auth/I420/stopped-positive claims are obsolete; roadmap must use current source and explicit evidence scope.
known_issues.next_action: Make this master reference authoritative, then align older docs separately

known_issues.title: Local/ignored asset dependencies limit reproducibility
known_issues.impact: Scenario configs/videos/outputs/weights ignored; host NumPy2.5.2 differs from runtime pin2.4.6; host service uses absolute user paths.
known_issues.next_action: Record a portable asset manifest, versions and deployment procedure
